constellations.desc: After Illuga triggers a <color=#FFE699FF>Geo-related Reaction</color> on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.
constellations.name: Vigilant Sentinel

constellations.desc: When Elemental Burst {LINK#S11275}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadowless Reflection</color>{/LINK}'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK} consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
constellations.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Earthshaking Maw

constellations.desc: When Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.
constellations.name: Solarhunting Wolf

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Hurricane Steed

constellations.desc:
Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1272101}Torchforger's Covenant{/LINK}</color>: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:</color>
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "<color=#FFD780FF>Torchforger's Covenant</color>."
constellations.name: Nightmare Orioles

passives.desc:
After unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> or Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> 
Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.
passives.name: Torchforger's Covenant

passives.desc: {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}'s effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.
passives.name: Demonhunter's Dusk

passives.desc: When Illuga is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Unwithering in Winter

passives.desc: At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.\nDoes not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.\nAdditionally, Illuga appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...
passives.name: Night Warden's Stride

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Oathkeeper's Spear

skills.desc:
Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to enemies it comes into contact with.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents it comes into contact with.
skills.name: Dawnbearing Songbird

skills.desc:
Light the lamp, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color>, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Construct</color> on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.
skills.name: Shadowless Reflection

const1.description: 叶洛亚在场上触发<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素相关反应</color>后，将为叶洛亚恢复12点元素能量，该效果每15秒至多触发一次。
const1.name: 告警之雉

const2.description: 元素爆发{LINK#S11275}<color=#FFD780FF>鉴照无影</color>{/LINK}中的「魇夜的莺歌」效果持续期间，每消耗7层{LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>「夜莺之歌」</color>{/LINK}，叶洛亚都将唤出阿咚，对周围一名敌人造成一次<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，伤害值基于叶洛亚元素精通的400%与防御力的200%，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。
const2.name: 噬枝之麋

const3.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 山吼之罴

const4.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>中的「魇夜的莺歌」效果持续期间，队伍中附近的当前场上角色防御力提升200点。
const4.name: 逐日之狼

const5.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}衔莺破晓{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 啸风之马

const6.description:
突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1272101}铸灯者的盟约{/LINK}</color>中「执灯之誓」的效果获得强化：对敌人造成的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，暴击率提升10%，暴击伤害提升30%。

<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color> 
处于「执灯之誓」效果影响下的角色，元素精通提升80点。
需要解锁突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>铸灯者的盟约</color>。
const6.name: 魇夜之莺

hyperlinks.description: 叶洛亚施放元素爆发鉴照无影后获得的效果，可以提升当前场上角色造成的岩元素伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 「夜莺之歌」

info.description: 调查分队「魇夜之莺」成员，执灯人最年轻的分队长。
info.name: 叶洛亚
info.title: 魇夜燃芯

p1.description:
施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}衔莺破晓{/LINK}</color>或元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>后，队伍中附近的其他角色将获得持续20秒的「执灯之誓」效果：对敌人造成的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，暴击率提升5%，暴击伤害提升10%。

<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color> 
处于「执灯之誓」效果影响下的角色，元素精通提升50点。
p1.name: 铸灯者的盟约

p2.description: {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>「夜莺之歌」</color>{/LINK}的效果获得强化：当队伍中存在1/2/3名<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>或<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>角色时，「夜莺之歌」会进一步提升造成的伤害，提升值相当于叶洛亚元素精通的7%/14%/24%；若上述伤害为月结晶反应造成的伤害，提升值则相当于叶洛亚元素精通的48%/96%/160%。
p2.name: 狩魔者的黄昏

p3.description: 叶洛亚在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
p3.name: 月兆祝赐·凌冬不凋

p4.description: 在夜间（18时至6时），队伍中自己的角色获得迅行效果：移动速度提高10%。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效，迅行效果无法叠加。\n此外，叶洛亚似乎能听懂狂猎的低语…
p4.name: 巡夜者的疾行

elementalburst.description: 点亮灯火，造成岩元素范围伤害，并获得「魇夜的莺歌」效果，持续20秒：持续期间，叶洛亚获得21层{LINK#N11270001}「夜莺之歌」{/LINK}，队伍中附近的当前场上角色的普通攻击、重击、下落攻击、元素战技或元素爆发对敌人造成岩元素伤害时，将消耗1层「夜莺之歌」，提升造成的伤害，提升值基于叶洛亚的元素精通；若该伤害为月结晶反应造成的伤害，还会进一步提升造成的伤害。 通过上述方式造成的岩元素伤害同时命中多名敌人时，会依据命中敌人的数量消耗「夜莺之歌」的层数。 此外，叶洛亚在场上存在队伍中附近的角色创造的岩元素创造物的情况下施放元素爆发时，或在「魇夜的莺歌」持续期间，队伍中附近的角色创造了岩元素创造物时，场上的每个岩元素创造物都会使叶洛亚额外获得5层「夜莺之歌」。每次施放元素爆发后的20秒内，叶洛亚至多通过这种方式额外获得15层「夜莺之歌」。 「夜莺之歌」的层数耗尽时，或持续时间结束时，「魇夜的莺歌」效果将会解除。 「谁掌中灯火不灭，就不必陷入如此黑暗。」
elementalburst.name: 鉴照无影

elementalskill.description: 唤出并肩作战的信鸟「阿咚」，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果。 点按 阿咚冲向前方的敌人，对触及的敌人造成岩元素伤害。 长按 进行瞄准，并使阿咚冲向被瞄准的敌人，对触及的敌人造成岩元素伤害。 与月矩力共生的信鸟「阿咚」是这片土地的守护者，即便面对凶恶的狂猎也从不退缩。
elementalskill.name: 衔莺破晓

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多四段的连续枪击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 守誓枪术

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:</color>
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "<color=#FFD780FF>Torchforger's Covenant</color>."
constellations.name: Nightmare Orioles

passives.desc:
After unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> or Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> 
Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.
passives.name: Torchforger's Covenant

passives.desc: {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}'s effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.
passives.name: Demonhunter's Dusk

passives.desc: When Illuga is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Unwithering in Winter

passives.desc: At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.\nDoes not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.\nAdditionally, Illuga appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...
passives.name: Night Warden's Stride

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Oathkeeper's Spear

skills.desc:
Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to enemies it comes into contact with.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents it comes into contact with.
skills.name: Dawnbearing Songbird

skills.desc:
Light the lamp, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color>, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Construct</color> on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.
skills.name: Shadowless Reflection

constellations.desc: 叶洛亚在场上触发<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素相关反应</color>后，将为叶洛亚恢复12点元素能量，该效果每15秒至多触发一次。
constellations.name: 告警之雉

constellations.desc: 元素爆发{LINK#S11275}<color=#FFD780FF>鉴照无影</color>{/LINK}中的「魇夜的莺歌」效果持续期间，每消耗7层{LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>「夜莺之歌」</color>{/LINK}，叶洛亚都将唤出阿咚，对周围一名敌人造成一次<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，伤害值基于叶洛亚元素精通的400%与防御力的200%，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。
constellations.name: 噬枝之麋

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 山吼之罴

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>中的「魇夜的莺歌」效果持续期间，队伍中附近的当前场上角色防御力提升200点。
constellations.name: 逐日之狼

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}衔莺破晓{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 啸风之马

constellations.desc:
突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1272101}铸灯者的盟约{/LINK}</color>中「执灯之誓」的效果获得强化：对敌人造成的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，暴击率提升10%，暴击伤害提升30%。

<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color> 
处于「执灯之誓」效果影响下的角色，元素精通提升80点。
需要解锁突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>铸灯者的盟约</color>。
constellations.name: 魇夜之莺

passives.desc:
施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}衔莺破晓{/LINK}</color>或元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}鉴照无影{/LINK}</color>后，队伍中附近的其他角色将获得持续20秒的「执灯之誓」效果：对敌人造成的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>，暴击率提升5%，暴击伤害提升10%。

<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color> 
处于「执灯之誓」效果影响下的角色，元素精通提升50点。
passives.name: 铸灯者的盟约

passives.desc: {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>「夜莺之歌」</color>{/LINK}的效果获得强化：当队伍中存在1/2/3名<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>或<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>角色时，「夜莺之歌」会进一步提升造成的伤害，提升值相当于叶洛亚元素精通的7%/14%/24%；若上述伤害为月结晶反应造成的伤害，提升值则相当于叶洛亚元素精通的48%/96%/160%。
passives.name: 狩魔者的黄昏

passives.desc: 叶洛亚在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
passives.name: 月兆祝赐·凌冬不凋

passives.desc: 在夜间（18时至6时），队伍中自己的角色获得迅行效果：移动速度提高10%。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效，迅行效果无法叠加。\n此外，叶洛亚似乎能听懂狂猎的低语…
passives.name: 巡夜者的疾行

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多四段的连续枪击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
skills.name: 守誓枪术

skills.desc:
唤出并肩作战的信鸟「阿咚」，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果。

<color=#FFD780FF>点按</color>
阿咚冲向前方的敌人，对触及的敌人造成<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>长按</color>
进行瞄准，并使阿咚冲向被瞄准的敌人，对触及的敌人造成<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>。
skills.name: 衔莺破晓

skills.desc:
点亮灯火，造成<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素范围伤害</color>，并获得「魇夜的莺歌」效果，持续20秒：持续期间，叶洛亚获得21层{LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>「夜莺之歌」</color>{/LINK}，队伍中附近的当前场上角色的普通攻击、重击、下落攻击、元素战技或元素爆发对敌人造成<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>时，将消耗1层「夜莺之歌」，提升造成的伤害，提升值基于叶洛亚的元素精通；若该伤害为月结晶反应造成的伤害，还会进一步提升造成的伤害。
通过上述方式造成的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>同时命中多名敌人时，会依据命中敌人的数量消耗「夜莺之歌」的层数。

此外，叶洛亚在场上存在队伍中附近的角色创造的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素创造物</color>的情况下施放元素爆发时，或在「魇夜的莺歌」持续期间，队伍中附近的角色创造了<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素创造物</color>时，场上的每个<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素创造物</color>都会使叶洛亚额外获得5层「夜莺之歌」。每次施放元素爆发后的20秒内，叶洛亚至多通过这种方式额外获得15层「夜莺之歌」。

「夜莺之歌」的层数耗尽时，或持续时间结束时，「魇夜的莺歌」效果将会解除。
skills.name: 鉴照无影
